signal: Trovata acquired ATOM and raised a $9M Series B extension from State Street and PNC in July 2025, then launched CORP$, a stablecoin service for corporate treasury, in December.

email.body1:
Keith, saw Trovata acquired ATOM, took new funding from State Street and PNC, and launched CORP$ for corporate treasury.

Moving up-market that fast usually means more enterprise treasury buyers in play than the team can cover, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Trovata off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Keith, quick follow-up for Trovata.

With the ATOM acquisition and CORP$ widening the offering, the enterprise pipeline target probably grew faster than the team can. Most sales leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Trovata needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Keith, last bit of proof for Trovata.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trovata's reply rate likely compares to peer fintech and treasury teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Keith, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know integrating an acquisition keeps a sales calendar packed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to Trovata's enterprise motion? I will tailor it to you either way.
